sourcing.title: Product sourcing
sourcing.subtitle: Browse DSers, CJ Dropshipping, Spocket, and POD catalogs, filter by ship-to region and delivery speed, then import listings that meet the 10-unit stock minimum.
sourcing.catalogSubtitle: Filter DSers, CJ Dropshipping, Spocket, and POD (Printful / Printify) catalogs in one place.
sourcing.emptySearch: Run a search to load supplier products.
sourcing.emptySearchDev: Run a search to load supplier products (mock catalogs when live API keys are unset).
sourcing.catalogUnreachable: Could not reach supplier catalog API.
sourcing.importSuccess: Imported into your store (product {id}…). Keep building toward {min} active items for the fee floor.
sourcing.fastStrategiesBody: Prefer regional warehouses (US / EU / SEA), filter for fast dispatch (≤7 days), and favor carriers such as DHL, FedEx, or ePacket when the supplier exposes them.
sourcing.routeManagerSubtitle: Attach CJ, DSers, Spocket, POD, or warehouse routes per buyer region for catalog source products.
sourcing.noSourceProducts: No source catalog products yet. Import from the multi-supplier catalog above, or add a product and attach regional supplier routes.
sourcing.importLimitReached: Import limit reached. Archive listings or upgrade before importing more.
